sources.title: Imperial Brands to cut up to 4,600 jobs by 2030
sources.description: Britain's Imperial Brands will cut up to 4,600 jobs, or nearly a fifth of its workforce, by 2030, it said today, as the tobacco company tightens its grip on costs.

sources.title: Imperial Brands jobs up in smoke as 4,600 staff face axe
sources.description: The Golden Virginia and Gauloises maker said this morning it plans to cut between 2,100 and 2,500 jobs from its global workforce by the end of 2030. It comes on top of the 2,100 job losses already identified in the year ended 30 September 2026
